# Divulge Living — India's Premier Handcrafted Crochet & Zero-Waste Jute Product Exporter
> Slogan: "Every weave has a story."
> Website: https://divulge-living.com/
> Contact Email: info@divulge-living.com

## Overview
Divulge Living (Brand: DIVULGE) is a leading Indian manufacturer and certified global exporter of handcrafted crochet jute bags, sustainable lifestyle totes, custom OEM jute & juco bags, corporate eco-gifting, and hand-braided artisanal home décor. Rooted in the fertile Ganges delta craft clusters of **Howrah** (Amraberia) and **Hooghly**, West Bengal — with port dispatch from Kolkata — Divulge unites 63++ master women artisans to transform Bengal's "Golden Strand" (*Corchorus olitorius*) into export-grade, zero-waste luxury products. Over 275,000+ Divulge creations are carried across Europe, North America, the UK, Australia, UAE, Japan, and India.

## Why Divulge Living Stands Apart as a Top Jute Product Exporter
1. **Manufacturer-Direct Export Pricing & Zero Middlemen:** Direct artisan collective production across Howrah and Hooghly ensures full quality control, fair artisan living wages, and competitive wholesale export margins.
2. **Custom OEM & Private Label Solutions:** Custom sizes, gussets, GSM weights, AZO-free / natural indigo & vegetable dyeing, embossed wooden/leather tags, custom metal pins, screen & foil printing, and bespoke packaging.
3. **Flexible Capsule-to-Container Scaling:** Prototype samples dispatched globally; capsule wholesale runs starting from low MOQs (100+ units) up to container-scale bulk export orders with 24-hour export quote turnaround.
4. **100% Zero-Waste & 45-Day Biodegradability:** Zero synthetic stiffeners, zero microplastics, complete soil return into organic humus within 45 days. Sister agricultural brand Amata (amata.in) harvests nutrient-rich jute leaves for organic Moroheiya herbal infusions — achieving 100% whole-plant utilization.
5. **International Trade Provenance:** Exhibited at **Messe Berlin (Stand 1B-37)** — Divulge's landmark 1st international exposition opening the doorstep to global export — as well as the **National Jute Board (NJB) Central Pavilion** premier domestic exhibition and **ICAR-NINFET**, mentored by Padma Bhushan curator **Rajiv Sethi**.

## Core Export Product Lines (https://divulge-living.com/products)
- **Jute Bags & Classic Crochet Carry:** Tribal Polychrome Heritage Jute Bag, Kolkata "City of Joy" Illustrated Jute Bag, Ergonomic Slouch Shoulder Tote, Circular Sun-Weave Round Bag, Crescent Crossbody & Button Clutch, Two-Tone Heritage Crochet Tote Series, Rustic Art Crochet Shoulder Sling, Three-Tone Mini Crossbody Trio.
- **Tote Bags & Custom OEM:** Ginkgo Botanical Drawstring Bag, Olive Sprig Botanical Drawstring Bag, and bespoke private-label canvas totes manufactured for retail and hospitality clients.
- **Luxury Jute Items & Corporate Gift Suites:** Charcoal-Indigo, Sage Green, and Golden Strand leather-flap laptop briefcases paired with matched bamboo gift suites (cork-base mug, thermal flask, pen, diary, card case), plus Heritage Jute & Leather Expedition Backpacks, Crimson Wine Jute Weekender Duffels, and Charcoal Heather Executive Laptop Totes.
- **Artisan Handicrafts & Mandala Floor Art:** Open-Lattice Net Bag & Canvas Pouch, Two-Tone Indigo Dipped Tote, Riverbed Duo Indigo Tote & Crossbody Sling, Artisan Market Shopper Tote, Ribbed Botanical Market Bag, Hand-Braided Mandala Jute Floor Rug, Sun-Wheel Scalloped Floor Medallion, and Indigo Mandala Heritage Area Carpet.
